Elaine (CS): Quick kickoff — SummitEdge dedicated pool dry-run tomorrow 09:00 PT. Objective: validate quota + autoscale + fallback routing before go-live. Target QPS: 2k sustained, spike to 4k for 15m. Quota committed = 120k/min. Who's running the load script and where will results land?
Mohit (SRE): I can run it from our perf cluster. Plan to use k6 from default runner; push metrics to perf-influx. Need confirmation on rate limits and warm cache plan.
Ryan (Ops): I will make sure the dedicated pool is carved and KMS key is accessible. ETA for slot allocation is 08:30 PT tomorrow. I'll also pre-stage the fallback model variant in us-west-2.
Dena (SummitEdge): Thanks — we can have two engineers on standby. Can we keep a 30-min window for manual throttle if errors spike? Also need a smoke test for inference correctness early in the run.
Elaine (CS): Yes to manual throttle window. Smoke test step: 50 samples across endpoints, verify latency < 200ms p95 and correctness checks (schema + top-3 tokens sanity).
Mohit (SRE): Load profile I'm planning: steady ramp to 2k over 10m, hold 30m, then spike to 4k for 15m, cool down 20m. Script: 
```bash
k6 run --vus 400 --duration 10m load/steady.js --out influxdb=http://perf-influx:8086
# then ramp script for spike
```
I'll tag the run with: summit-edge-dryrun-178980.
Ryan (Ops): Autoscale config note: target utilization = 0.65, min_replicas = 2, max_replicas = 18. If we hit >80% for 2m, autoscaler will add nodes. We'll watch GPU mem pressure too.
Dena (SummitEdge): What about 429 handling? We need predictable retry semantics on client side and a fallback to the smaller base model if errors persist > 3m.
Elaine (CS): Agree — rollout policy: primary -> fallback model variant after 3m sustained 5xx/429 rate > 2%. Ops to validate fallback works (feature parity smoke).
Mohit (SRE): I'll wire alerts: 5xx rate >1% (sev2), 429 rate >2% (sev2), p95 latency >500ms (sev3). Also log sample responses for correctness diffing.
Ryan (Ops): KMS check: I verified key ARN has decrypt for the node-role. Secret rotation scheduled after the dry-run. No blockers.
DeployBot: Deploy started for summit-edge: model-version:v2 -> dedicated-pool-usw2 at 08:35 PT. (logs: https://ci.internal/deploy/789) :rocket:
Elaine (CS): Can someone paste exact command path for the load script and the location of results after run? Need to attach to the customer ticket.
Mohit (SRE): Load scripts are in repo: git@internal:redwood/perf-loads.git path: loads/summit-edge/steady.js. Results -> perf-influx bucket `summit_edge_dryrun` and dashboard: https://grafana.internal/d/summitedge-dryrun
Dena (SummitEdge): We'll validate correctness in parallel. Please call out any mismatches on this thread.
Ryan (Ops): Quick checklist I've created: 
- pool ready by 08:30 PT
- KMS verified
- fallback model staged
- rollback playbook on standby (ops-runbook/rollback-summit.md)
- oncall assigned: Mohit -> primary, Ryan -> infra
I'll post final readiness ping at 08:40 PT.
Elaine (CS): Acceptance criteria summary for CS: (1) sustained 2k QPS with p95 < 300ms for 30m, (2) graceful autoscale from 2->X replicas without errors, (3) fallback test passes, (4) no customer-facing 5xx during run.
Mohit (SRE): Noted. I'll start a background dry-run in staging today at low load to validate scripts and dashboards. Will link logs here when done.
Elaine (CS): Perfect. Final note — capture feedback from SummitEdge team post-run; we'll include a short survey and a 30m wrap call at 12:30 PT. Agenda: results, risks, recommended autoscale tweaks.
Dena (SummitEdge): Sounds good — team ready. See you tomorrow. :thumbsup:
DeployBot: Load test scheduled job created: job-id=lk-99321, cron=@once 2026-03-23T16:00:00Z.
Mohit (SRE): Staging smoke done, small fix to headers in steady.js. Pushed PR -> merging now.
Elaine (CS): Thanks everyone — attaching checklist and post-run survey to the ticket: https://notion.redwood/summitedge-dryrun. Will update thread after results.
